decisions.issue: Prior P4 Base and accepted C04 lineage diverged at their common parent.
decisions.chosen_correction: Reapply the bounded P4 Base delta onto exact C04 final and preserve C04 as ancestry base.
decisions.proof: C04 ancestor check passed; first 85 migration paths have zero diff.

decisions.issue: Reserve approval must not trust caller economics or duplicate an effect under contention.
decisions.chosen_correction: Load exact C04 instruction server-side; preserve immutable membership audit tuples; serialize by Brand/idempotency/instruction; use unique constraints and bounded serialization retry.
decisions.proof: Two concurrent calls produced one completed approval, one successful attempt, and one reserve ledger effect; changed payload, shortfall, RBAC, and cross-Brand cases failed closed.

decisions.issue: Creator obligation and due authority require exact C04 lineage and finite term semantics.
decisions.chosen_correction: Persist canonical C04 references and calculate the UTC due instant from settlementEligibleAt with the Asia/Kolkata NET_7/15/30/45/60 rule.
decisions.proof: PostgreSQL triggers and service tests reject incomplete/currentness mismatch and verify all five allowed terms; IMMEDIATE is excluded.

decisions.issue: Provider-neutral execution must not infer destination authority or collapse create, observation, and settlement.
decisions.chosen_correction: Fence exact current Creator-owned C05 destination/version/mapping at claim; keep distinct provider calls and settle only from observed evidence with exact funding consumption.
decisions.proof: C05 mutation is rejected, transfer replay calls create once, settlement replay writes one ledger effect, and immutable receipts reject deletion.
decisions.residual_risk: A crash after remote acceptance but before local result persistence remains fail-closed for manual reconciliation; it cannot issue a duplicate with the same local active attempt. Provider-enabled recovery is outside P5A.

decisions.chosen_correction: Select a no-SDK fail-closed provider by default and expose provider-unavailable state without creating an attempt.
decisions.proof: Migrated PostgreSQL acceptance recorded one capability read and zero create/read/reversal methods or transfer attempts.
